plain_meaning: Growth needs electricity that is generated, delivered, approved, and paid for.
who_gets_paid: generators, utilities, contractors, equipment suppliers, recovery-approved asset owners
examples_or_company_sets: Constellation; Vistra; NRG; Exelon; Duke; AEP; NextEra/FPL; Sterling; MasTec
proof_boundary: Load, capex, tariffs, and plans are not customer receipt or project-return proof.

plain_meaning: Big managers and insurers route savings into assets, borrowers, projects, and credit.
who_gets_paid: asset managers, insurers, BDCs, credit funds, infrastructure vehicles, private-market platforms
examples_or_company_sets: BlackRock; Blackstone; Apollo/Athene; KKR/Global Atlantic; Brookfield; Ares; Carlyle
proof_boundary: AUM, inflows, dry powder, and originations are not named borrower receipt or asset return proof.

plain_meaning: Physical work depends on equipment, parts, supply, technical support, and execution.
who_gets_paid: equipment rental firms, distributors, MRO suppliers, project executors
examples_or_company_sets: United Rentals; Fastenal; WESCO; Grainger; Applied Industrial; MSC; Watsco; Sterling; MasTec
proof_boundary: Sales, fleet OEC, and backlog are not fleet-class ROIC or project collection proof.

plain_meaning: Medical demand must become care that is staffed, reimbursed, scheduled, and trusted.
who_gets_paid: payers, care operators, pharmacy routers, home-care providers, specialty service firms
examples_or_company_sets: UnitedHealth; Cigna; DaVita; Option Care; Addus; BrightSpring; Enhabit
proof_boundary: Volume and revenue do not prove outcomes, fairness, reimbursement quality, or cash collection.

plain_meaning: Shelter, water, repair, construction, and civic systems keep needing maintenance.
who_gets_paid: home centers, builders, distributors, waterworks suppliers, materials firms
examples_or_company_sets: Home Depot; Lowe's; Builders FirstSource; Sherwin-Williams; West Fraser; Ferguson; Core & Main
proof_boundary: Sales and addressable-market claims are not branch cash, project receipt, or acquisition-return proof.

plain_meaning: More online activity needs permission, identity, security, routing, and governance.
who_gets_paid: security firms, network platforms, infrastructure software, edge networks, creator platforms
examples_or_company_sets: Cloudflare; Akamai; Fastly; Zscaler; Fortinet; DigitalOcean; Roblox
proof_boundary: ARR, RPO, traffic, bookings, and users are not durable product-level cash proof.

plain_meaning: Pressured households spend through formats that reduce regret.
who_gets_paid: warehouse clubs, mass merchants, dollar stores, off-price retailers
examples_or_company_sets: Costco; Walmart; Target; Dollar General; Dollar Tree; Burlington; Ollie's
proof_boundary: Traffic, comps, and membership fees are not durable cohort or channel-level cash proof.

plain_meaning: People buy time, relief, travel, status, convenience, attention, and experience.
who_gets_paid: lodging, restaurants, casinos, airlines, advertising, entertainment, staffing
examples_or_company_sets: lodging; restaurants; resorts/casinos; airlines; advertising; entertainment; staffing
proof_boundary: Service revenue does not automatically prove consumer health or durable discretionary demand.

plain_meaning: Households defend routines, trust, cleanliness, beauty, food habits, and small control.
who_gets_paid: brands, packaged-food companies, personal-care firms, beauty companies, toy companies, packaging firms
examples_or_company_sets: P&G; Colgate; Kimberly-Clark; e.l.f.; Estee Lauder; Coca-Cola; Mondelez; General Mills; Hasbro; Mattel; Crocs
proof_boundary: Sales do not prove brand durability, pricing power, or cash quality.

plain_meaning: Buildout depends on copper, steel, fertilizer, chemicals, lumber, aggregates, uranium, and other inputs.
who_gets_paid: miners, steelmakers, chemical producers, fertilizer producers, aggregates firms, lumber producers
examples_or_company_sets: Freeport-McMoRan; Southern Copper; Nucor; West Fraser; CF Industries; Nutrien; Mosaic; Dow; CRH; Vulcan; Cameco
proof_boundary: End-market demand does not guarantee pricing power or high returns for every materials company.

plain_meaning: Towers, logistics sites, medical locations, housing, hotels, data centers, and stores depend on specific places.
who_gets_paid: REITs, tower owners, hotel owners, logistics landlords, healthcare landlords, developers
examples_or_company_sets: American Tower; Crown Castle; Equinix; Prologis; Welltower; Ventas; Host Hotels; AvalonBay; Simon Property
proof_boundary: Owning property does not prove pricing power, tenant quality, or cash durability.

plain_meaning: Modern activity depends on application software, chips, networking, storage, telecom, security, and hardware.
who_gets_paid: software firms, chip companies, network equipment makers, storage firms, IT services, telecom providers
examples_or_company_sets: Microsoft; Oracle; Adobe; Snowflake; Nvidia; Broadcom; Cisco; Ciena; Dell; ServiceNow; Accenture
proof_boundary: AI exposure, ARR, traffic, orders, or user counts are not durable value proof.

plain_meaning: Care also depends on devices, labs, hospitals, drug distribution, diagnostics, supplies, and biotech.
who_gets_paid: device makers, labs, distributors, hospitals, diagnostic firms, biotech firms
examples_or_company_sets: Abbott; Baxter; Becton Dickinson; Boston Scientific; Dexcom; Stryker; Thermo Fisher; Labcorp; McKesson; HCA; Regeneron
proof_boundary: More healthcare volume does not prove outcomes, access fairness, or cash quality.

plain_meaning: Daily life and industry depend on production, refining, services, pipelines, storage, and usable fuel cost.
who_gets_paid: upstream producers, refiners, service firms, equipment suppliers, midstream operators
examples_or_company_sets: EOG; Devon; Diamondback; EQT; Occidental; Valero; Marathon Petroleum; Phillips 66; PBF; SLB; Halliburton
proof_boundary: Volume, commodity price, or refining margin strength does not prove durable cash return.

plain_meaning: Households and businesses feel pressure through deposits, cards, loans, insurance, payments, and brokerage channels.
who_gets_paid: banks, card lenders, credit services, insurance brokers, P&C insurers, payment and exchange firms
examples_or_company_sets: JPMorgan; Bank of America; Citigroup; American Express; Synchrony; Aon; Gallagher; Marsh McLennan; Chubb; Markel
proof_boundary: Scale does not prove customer health, credit quality, or productive use of money.
